fields.description: Enables content-based deduplication for FIFO queues.
Specifies whether message deduplication occurs at the message group or queue level. Valid values are messageGroup and queue.
Time in seconds that the delivery of all messages in the queue will be delayed. An integer from 0 to 900 (15 minutes).
Boolean designating a FIFO queue. If not set, it defaults to false making it standard.
Specifies whether the FIFO queue throughput quota applies to the entire queue or per message group. Valid values are perQueue and perMessageGroupId.
The length of time, in seconds, for which Amazon SQS can reuse a data key to encrypt or decrypt messages before calling KMS again.
The ID of an AWS-managed customer master key (CMK) for Amazon SQS or a custom CMK.
Limit of how many bytes a message can contain before Amazon SQS rejects it. An integer from 1024 bytes (1 KiB) up to 262144 bytes (256 KiB).
Number of seconds Amazon SQS retains a message. Integer from 60 (1 minute) to 1209600 (14 days).
Name of the queue. Queue names must be made up of only uppercase and lowercase ASCII letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.
The JSON policy for the SQS queue.
Time for which a ReceiveMessage call will wait for a message to arrive (long polling) before returning. An integer from 0 to 20 seconds.
JSON policy to set up the Dead Letter Queue redrive permission, see AWS docs.
JSON policy to set up the Dead Letter Queue, see AWS docs.
Region where this resource will be managed. Most resources will use the region set in the provider config.
Boolean to enable server-side encryption of message content with SQS-owned encryption keys.
Visibility timeout for the queue. An integer from 0 to 43200 (12 hours).
